actualFrozenFixtureImpact: Not established by these isolated adversarial cases. Do not treat these tests as evidence that the in-flight frozen trace contains the problematic fields.
scope: Independent historical review of bdc1c26 narrow boundary trace format and producers. Newer live helper revisions are deliberately outside this artifact. This deliberately records counterexamples against a broader own-primitive/f64 interpretation. It does not mutate the helper, qualify a battle trace, or claim a simulator mismatch.

cases.finding: primitiveState uses an ordinary output object and assignment, invoking the inherited __proto__ setter for an encoded numeric value instead of creating an own field. The selected numeric field is silently omitted.

A real primitive-field dictionary consisting only of $boundaryNode equal to another valid node hash is accepted as a reference and silently reconstructed as that other node. The marker namespace is not separated from captured data keys.

classManagerCounters is copied as raw JSON data rather than tagged f64 bits. Special numeric values lose sign/type information. Actual supplied observer counters may be source-bounded integers; this test establishes the format limitation, not actual fixture drift.

Device output payloads preserve raw event objects, so JSON loses special f64 bits. Clock entries and caller-provided record payloads similarly bypass atom encoding. Actual payload-domain impact requires a separate frozen-fixture audit.

additionalProducerFindings: The inspected source producer records a loaded helper hash but lacks final unchanged-input checks for helper/emitter/producer/dependencies/tape/scenario. Frozen metadata scenario and host-tape declared hashes are not asserted before source execution.

The inspected native preparation validates original units/compiler at entry but lacks a final immutable dependency check across long compilation. A separate final execution/archive gate must bind loaded helper, tape, producer and actual objects/DSO at start and finish.
recommendations: Use a typed field-entry representation or reject reserved captured keys before recording; a null-prototype output dictionary alone repairs __proto__ assignment but does not separate reference tags from literal data.
Make numeric payload/observer domains explicit and either source-prove integer-only fields or tag every captured game Number with raw f64 bits.
Inspect actual completed snapshot pools for reserved-key dictionaries before claiming a particular frozen fixture is affected; preserve the currently loaded helper bytes during in-flight runs.

Keep whole-program, getter/unknown-Proxy, nested-object and actor/effect/view omissions explicit. Compare traced versus untraced original-source terminal reports and independently compare source/native ordered events and reconstructable nodes.
